builds.title: Astro Mission Control
builds.description: An observing dashboard: what is up tonight, the Moon and darkness, weather, planets, meteor showers, aurora and solar activity.

builds.title: Upcoming Rocket Launches
builds.description: A live countdown to the next rocket launch and a list of the following ten, with status.

builds.title: Earth Explorer
builds.description: Explore satellite imagery, global environmental indicators, and Earth observation datasets.

builds.title: Atmosphere Explorer
builds.description: Monitor atmospheric conditions, air quality indices, and meteorological telemetry.

builds.title: Sun Explorer
builds.description: Real-time solar monitoring, sunspot tracking, and solar flare telemetry.

builds.title: Solar System Explorer
builds.description: Interactive Orrery and planetary position tracker across the solar system.

builds.title: Space Trend Keeper
builds.description: Track macroeconomic, technological, and policy trends across the global space economy.

builds.title: Weather Dashboard
builds.description: Weather for any place: current conditions, the next 24 hours, radar, a 7-day forecast, air quality and pollen.

builds.title: Council Watch
builds.description: Monitor local government agendas, committee minutes, and municipal planning applications.

builds.title: Spice Cupboard & Mix Manager
builds.description: Keep track of the spices you have, and see which spice mixes you can make now or are one ingredient short of, with batch scaling.

builds.title: Mini Bar
builds.description: A home bar inventory and cocktail manager: record what you have and see which drinks you can make now.

builds.title: First Aid Kit Inventory
builds.description: Track the contents of your first aid kits: expiry dates, minimum quantities, inspection checklists and an automatic restock list.

builds.title: Kinship Notes
builds.description: Import a GEDCOM family tree, explore it as a whole tree, hourglass, pedigree, descendants or fan chart, and keep private research notes, questions and tasks against each person. Everything stays in your browser.

builds.title: Julian Date & Sidereal Time
builds.description: Convert between UTC, Julian date, modified Julian date and Unix time, and calculate Greenwich and local mean sidereal time. Also available as a small JSON API.

builds.title: Orbital Calculator
builds.description: Two-body orbit calculator. Enter a semi-major axis and eccentricity to get the period, periapsis and apoapsis radii and the speeds at each, using the vis-viva equation. Defaults to Earth's gravitational parameter.

builds.title: Hohmann Transfer Calculator
builds.description: Delta-v and transfer time for a two-impulse Hohmann transfer between two circular, coplanar orbits around the same body.

builds.title: Astronomy Calculator
builds.description: Observing and optics calculations for amateur astronomy, such as magnification, field of view, exit pupil and limiting magnitude.

builds.title: Deep-Sky Objects
builds.description: Explore deep-sky objects, coordinates, magnitudes, and visibility from your observing site.

builds.title: Light Pollution Estimator
builds.description: Estimate local sky brightness and Bortle class from a UK location, with practical guidance for visual observing.

builds.title: Optics Visualiser
builds.description: Move sliders for aperture, focal length and eyepiece to see magnification, exit pupil, field of view and resolution update beside a schematic ray diagram.

builds.title: Orbit Simulator
builds.description: Animate a two-body orbit from a central body, semi-major axis and eccentricity, with live distance, speed and true anomaly alongside the vis-viva quantities.

builds.title: Moon & Sun Calculator
builds.description: Calculate sunrise, sunset, twilight times, moonrise and moonset, Moon phase and illumination for a location and date.

builds.title: How Satellites See Earth
builds.description: Explore Earth observation imaging bands, spatial resolution, and swath widths across satellite sensors.

builds.title: Satellite Link Budget Calculator
builds.description: Calculate free space path loss, received power, and link margins for Earth-to-space RF communications.

builds.title: Galaxy Morphology Explorer
builds.description: Classify and explore galaxy types using the Hubble tuning fork sequence and structural parameters.

builds.title: Active vs Passive Satellites
builds.description: Compare active radar (SAR) and passive optical Earth observation payloads and their observational capabilities.

builds.title: Magnitude Difference Calculator
builds.description: Calculate brightness ratios and magnitude differences for stellar astronomy.

builds.title: Jupiter Moon Visualiser
builds.description: Simulate and visualise the orbital positions of Jupiter's Galilean moons (Io, Europa, Ganymede, Callisto).

builds.title: Angular Size Calculator
builds.description: Calculate the angular diameter or physical size of astronomical objects using distance and subtended angle.

builds.title: Unit Converter
builds.description: Convert between physics, engineering and astronomy units, from newtons and pascals to parsecs, solar masses and electronvolts. Also available as a small JSON API.

builds.title: Physical Limits
builds.description: Four gravitational limits in one calculator: escape velocity, Hill sphere, Roche limit and Schwarzschild radius.

builds.title: Chilli Heat Scale Explorer
builds.description: Slide along the Scoville scale, compare 14 peppers, find your comfort zone with a short quiz and estimate how much pepper a sauce needs.

builds.title: Cup Delta
builds.description: Calculate extraction yield, brew ratios, and TDS for espresso and filter coffee.

builds.title: Escape Velocity Calculator
builds.description: Calculate the escape velocity and gravitational binding energy for planets and celestial bodies.

builds.title: Carbon Reduction Plan Builder
builds.description: Record Scope 1, 2 and 3 emissions, track progress against a reduction target and export a printable Carbon Reduction Plan aligned with PPN 006.

builds.title: Flight Emissions Estimator
builds.description: Estimate greenhouse-gas emissions for a flight from origin and destination airports, cabin class and trip type. A modelled estimate, not a measurement.

builds.title: Home Energy Baseline
builds.description: Record electricity and gas use, estimate annual emissions, compare against UK benchmarks and identify practical reduction opportunities.

builds.title: Greenhouse Effect Model
builds.description: Interactive zero-dimensional energy balance climate model demonstrating radiative forcing and greenhouse gas warming.

builds.title: Dopamine Menu
builds.description: Pick a short, enjoyable or restorative break from your own menu, filtered by type, time and place. Your menu stays in your browser.

builds.title: Waiting-On Tracker
builds.description: Keep track of what you are waiting on and see what needs a nudge today. Snooze, resolve and reopen items, with a calm mode. Your list stays in your browser.

builds.title: Habit Streak Tracker
builds.description: Track simple daily habits with streaks, weekly summaries and local-browser storage. No account required.

builds.title: Context Switcher
builds.description: Quickly switch between workspace contexts and environments.

builds.title: Coordinate Converter
builds.description: Convert between latitude/longitude, British National Grid and other coordinate formats.

builds.title: Postcode Lookup
builds.description: Look up a UK postcode for its coordinates, constituency and LSOA.

builds.title: Colour Contrast Checker
builds.description: WCAG contrast ratios for foreground and background colours, with AA and AAA results and fix suggestions.

builds.title: SEO Meta Tag Checker
builds.description: Check a page’s title, description, Open Graph, Twitter card, canonical URL and robots directives against common SEO and sharing requirements.

builds.title: Marketing Dashboard
builds.description: Overview of campaign performance metrics, funnel conversion rates, and channel ROI.

builds.title: Marketing Funnel Calculator
builds.description: Model conversion rates, lead volumes, and customer acquisition costs across marketing funnel stages.

builds.title: Page Weight Audit
builds.description: Inspect a web page’s transferred bytes, largest assets, request count and caching headers, with practical performance and sustainability suggestions.

builds.title: Website Carbon Checker
builds.description: Estimate the carbon footprint of a web page from its transfer size, and check whether it is served from green hosting. A modelled estimate, not a measurement.

builds.title: Mechanics Lab
builds.description: Interactive demonstrations of forces, motion and energy, built to be explored rather than read.

builds.title: Electricity Lab
builds.description: A companion to the Mechanics Lab for exploring circuits, current, voltage and resistance.

builds.title: Elements Lab
builds.description: An interactive periodic table with a card for each element, for browsing properties and patterns.

builds.title: Astronomy Lab
builds.description: Visualisations and calculators for celestial coordinates, stellar properties, and sky mechanics.

builds.title: N-Body Gravitational Simulator
builds.description: Interactive gravitational simulation of multiple bodies interacting under Newtonian mechanics.

builds.title: Satellite Orbit Viewer
builds.description: Visualising satellite trajectories, ground tracks, and orbital parameters in real time.

builds.title: Maths Explorer
builds.description: Interactive mathematical functions, geometry, and transformation visualisers.

builds.title: Equation Solver
builds.description: Plot and explore physical and mathematical equations with live parameter adjustments.

builds.title: Graph Explorer
builds.description: A focused space for visualising data, testing ideas, and exploring charts in a clean, dark interface.

builds.title: Doppler & Redshift Visualiser
builds.description: Wavefronts and spectral lines showing Doppler shift, with a toggle between Doppler and cosmological redshift.

builds.title: Climate Visualiser
builds.description: An evidence-based look at the climate system, from atmosphere and ocean to sea level, including policy successes such as the Montreal Protocol.

builds.title: Climate Time Machine
builds.description: Historical and projected climate metrics visualization over decades and centuries.

builds.title: Fluid Dynamics (CFD) Simulator
builds.description: Simplified computational fluid dynamics browser simulation for airflow and fluid flow around obstacles.

builds.title: Biodiversity & Ecosystems
builds.description: Modelling population dynamics and habitat resilience under environmental stress.

builds.title: Drought & Precipitation Index
builds.description: Tracking meteorological and hydrological drought indicators across regional datasets.

builds.title: Wildfire Spread Model
builds.description: Cellular automaton model simulating wildfire propagation based on wind, terrain, and moisture.

builds.title: Water Quality & Discharge Monitor
builds.description: Visualising river catchment data, rainfall events, and storm overflow impact models.

builds.title: Earthquake Activity Monitor
builds.description: Real-time tracking and visualising global seismic activity and magnitude metrics.

builds.title: Earth System Model
builds.description: Interactive visualization of global energy balance, atmospheric circulation, and cryosphere dynamics.

builds.title: Components Sandbox
builds.description: A working gallery of the Astro UI blocks used across rjmlaird.co.uk — rendered live, with the source snippet underneath each one.

builds.title: Colour Contrast Checker
builds.description: WCAG 2.x colour contrast checker.

builds.title: Rubik's Cube State Analyser
builds.description: Interactive 3D cube manipulation and algorithm visualization.

builds.title: Blueprint Layout Grid
builds.description: Architectural and typographic grid layout prototyping utility.

builds.title: Marketing
builds.description: Visualising multi-channel marketing touchpoints and conversion paths.

builds.title: Earth Observation Dashboard
builds.description: Satellite telemetry and environmental metrics monitoring dashboard.

builds.title: Data Storytelling Studio
builds.description: Tools and templates for crafting narrative-driven data visualisations and reports.
